workflow: gen5_campaign1: seed versus GEPA-evolved runbooks on the Gen 5 family-instanced SOC Tier 1 suite

holdout_attestation.evidence: configs/evals/gen5/exposure.jsonl carries zero final_test entries at approval time (tests/test_gen5_exposure.py asserts it); final_test instances were materialized by scripts/gen5_instancer.py and never loaded by a model-facing runner.

hypotheses: H1 (in-distribution): on the 10 final_test instances of the seen families, GEPA-evolved runbooks score above the seed runbooks by more than tau_accept from noise_floor.json.

H2 (out of distribution): on the 20 final_test instances of the four held-out families, the evolved-minus-seed delta is reported; the campaign claims generalization only if it also exceeds tau_accept there.

H3 (attribution): the in-distribution delta minus the OOD delta is reported as the in-distribution premium; a positive premium with a null OOD delta is read as learned family structure, not improved judgment.

comparison.baseline: seed runbooks (the four CORE_RUNBOOKS from third_party/ai-runbooks)
comparison.candidate: configs/runbooks/gepa_evolved at the commit recorded in its evolution_metadata.json
comparison.in_distribution: final_test instances whose family_id is in split_plan.json role seen (10 cases)
comparison.out_of_distribution: final_test instances whose family_id is in split_plan.json role final_test_ood (20 cases)
comparison.scorer: scripts.verify_harbor_soc.compose_soc_reward, pass at reward >= 0.80, infra failures excluded

gen5.unseal_command: just eval-gen5 gemini-2.5-flash final_test '' 'gen5_campaign1 final comparison' -- after acceptance.approved_by and approved_at are set
